yamlCheck.dateAnchor: Neither a calendar date nor year is spoken for current play. August 25 and November 15, 1748 are YAML boundaries, not independently verified transcript anchors.
yamlCheck.explanation: The transcript establishes an ongoing approach, scouting, cave travel, a short rest and a three-hour march, then the dissolution of Morkalan and return-home choices. It establishes no complete count of calendar transitions. The historical century-and-a-half captivity, character backstories and spell durations do not supply elapsed session days. No transcript contradiction to the 82-day YAML span is established; the extended epilogue is not in this source.

limitations: The complete registered transcript ends at u3074 with departure choices. It contains no played account of the later escort, Tharn Todor stay, or reunion journey covered by the campaign session note and YAML end date.
